system.description:
Honor has no place on the battlefield, and you've found a way to become formidable without it. You are an expert at dirty fighting, using any cruel ploy at your disposal to gain an upper hand, however small- after all, battlefields across the land are littered with the corpses of those who chose to fight honorably.

Treachery deeds encompass a variety of tactics- many have the tool type, meaning they require a free hand to deploy some kind of item or instrument. Treacherous fighters excel at misdirecting, disabling and poisoning their enemies.
